description: Land Acquisition - Kennanthudawa, Millaniya D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains an order for taking possession of specific land parcels, including detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a minister's name (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers related to land matters rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core subject matter is land acquisition, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
